value.text: Hi! Registration for Ada's swim lessons opens Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. (Eastern). I saw two sessions: Preschool Swim Sat 9:00 ($98) and Preschool Swim Sun 10:00 ($98). If you say yes, I'll get in line at the open and fill in the registration for you, then text you the open browser so you can check it, submit and pay yourself. Please be ready to finish it soon after 7:00. One thing to know: if you also queue on your own phone or computer, your family will hold two places in line, and the town's queue counts that as more than one place. Could you tell me which sessions you want, in order of preference, and the most you're willing to pay? The link follows this message.
